verdict.rationale: Kick is an accounting SaaS, so subscribing to events via webhooks is a fair axis, but the evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The pack shows MCP, CLI, Google Sheets sync and internal rules that fire on transaction sync. These are pull-based or internal automations, not webhook subscriptions a programmatic consumer can receive, and the OpenAPI probe found no API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
